title: CampusGo / User service metrics
description: User-service metrics with backend traces available through the provisioned Tempo datasource. Logs remain stdout-only.

options.content: User-service sends OTLP to the Collector: metrics go to Prometheus, traces to Tempo (48-hour retention). Use Explore user-service traces above, or search a response X-Trace-Id in the Tempo datasource. Recorded exceptions appear in span events; logs remain stdout-only. Metrics have no native exemplars: trace-to-metric links open aggregate data for a matching time/service. Health checks are excluded from HTTP metrics by default.

panels.title: Collector scrape
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the application-metrics endpoint. UP alone does not prove the user service is exporting.

panels.title: Estimated HTTP requests in selected range
panels.description: Reset-aware extrapolated increase, not an exact audit count. Requires multiple scrapes and excludes health checks by default.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx fraction
panels.description: 5xx / all responses over the rate window. Idle or absent telemetry shows no value, rather than a fabricated healthy 0%.

panels.title: HTTP p95 latency
panels.description: Bucket-interpolated estimate of response-generation time; excludes streamed-body transmission. Sparse traffic/coarse exported buckets limit accuracy. Inspect actual runtime buckets before interpreting percentiles.

panels.title: HTTP request rate by route
panels.description: Request rate from application histograms. Normalized route templates prevent per-user URL labels.

panels.title: HTTP latency percentiles
panels.description: Bucket-interpolated estimate of response-generation time; excludes streamed-body transmission. Sparse traffic/coarse exported buckets limit accuracy. Inspect actual runtime buckets before interpreting percentiles.

panels.title: HTTP request rate by status
panels.description: Successful responses, client errors, and server errors. Expected 4xx outcomes remain separate from server failures.

panels.title: Messaging operation rate
panels.description: User-service publication and RPC activity. No samples is normal before these operations run.

panels.title: Messaging p95 latency
panels.description: Includes round-trip time for rpc.call and publisher-confirmation time for publish/reply operations.

panels.title: Outbox publication outcome rate
panels.description: Relay attempts classified as success, retry, or exhausted. Includes completion bookkeeping failures.

panels.title: Estimated outbox outcomes in selected range
panels.description: Attempt outcomes, not unique deliveries. A completion bookkeeping failure after confirmation can trigger a retry.

panels.title: Average HTTP response-generation latency
panels.description: Sum of recorded seconds / response count over the rate window. No traffic has no average. Excludes body transmission.

panels.title: Application telemetry age
panels.description: Age of a timestamp emitted by the application. Collector UP alone cannot prove fresh application exports.

panels.title: Outbox snapshot age
panels.description: Snapshot polls every 30s. Backlog is unavailable after 90s without success; application state is unavailable after 45s without heartbeat.

panels.title: Outbox backlog
panels.description: Row counts from campusgo_outbox_backlog, with no ratio suffix. Ready + delayed = pending. Failed rows exhausted retries. Shared database snapshots must not be summed across replicas.

targets.expr: max by (state) (campusgo_outbox_backlog{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) and on() (((time() - max(campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) < 45)) and on() (max(campusgo_outbox_snapshot_available{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1))

panels.title: Oldest pending event age
panels.description: Age of the oldest ready or delayed event. Zero only when a fresh snapshot contains no pending rows.

panels.title: RabbitMQ connection available
panels.description: Unitless 0/1 state, not a percentage. 1 = user-service connection open; 0 = connecting/disconnected/closed. Initial connection failures remain 0.

panels.title: Outbox worker running
panels.description: Unitless 0/1 state, not a percentage. 1 = relay loop running. Also inspect poll age; a running worker may be stalled.

panels.title: Outbox enqueue-to-confirmation p95
panels.description: Per confirmed attempt, from row creation to broker confirmation. Retries may repeat observations; this does not measure downstream consumption.

panels.title: Database operation p95
panels.description: Logical repository calls and business transactions, not individual SQL statements. Nested timings overlap; do not add them.

panels.title: RPC terminal outcomes / second
panels.description: Caller-side outcomes. User-service currently serves RPC but has no normal outbound RPC calls, so this panel can remain empty.

panels.title: Active HTTP requests
panels.description: Response generation only. Global count; route filter does not apply to in-flight requests.

panels.title: Total pending outbox events
panels.description: Row count from campusgo_outbox_backlog (ready + delayed), excluding exhausted rows. Hidden when the database snapshot or application telemetry is stale.

targets.expr: sum(max by (state) (campusgo_outbox_backlog{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",state=~"ready|delayed"})) and on() (((time() - max(campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) < 45)) and on() (max(campusgo_outbox_snapshot_available{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1))

panels.title: Outbox snapshot available
panels.description: Unitless 0/1 state, not a percentage. 1 = last successful database snapshot is at most 90s old; 0 = no successful or sufficiently fresh snapshot. Missing = stale application telemetry.

panels.title: Current accounts
panels.description: Durable current-state snapshot, not distinct active users or lifetime registrations. No value means unavailable/stale, not zero. Independent of the HTTP route filter.

targets.expr: sum(max by (state) (campusgo_user_accounts{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}"})) and on() (((time() - max(campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) < 45)) and on() (max(campusgo_user_snapshot_available{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1))

panels.title: Not suspended accounts
panels.description: Durable current-state snapshot, not distinct active users or lifetime registrations. No value means unavailable/stale, not zero. Independent of the HTTP route filter.

targets.expr: sum(max by (state) (campusgo_user_accounts{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",state="not_suspended"})) and on() (((time() - max(campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) < 45)) and on() (max(campusgo_user_snapshot_available{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1))

panels.title: Suspended accounts
panels.description: Durable current-state snapshot, not distinct active users or lifetime registrations. No value means unavailable/stale, not zero. Independent of the HTTP route filter.

targets.expr: sum(max by (state) (campusgo_user_accounts{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}",state="suspended"})) and on() (((time() - max(campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) < 45)) and on() (max(campusgo_user_snapshot_available{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1))

panels.title: Authentication outcomes / second
panels.description: Final POST response outcomes: 2xx success, 4xx rejected, 5xx error, other statuses other. Includes validation failures and refresh attempts; does not classify root causes or distinct users. Independent of the HTTP route filter.

panels.title: Accounts by suspension state
panels.description: Not suspended is an account flag, not recent activity. Shared database snapshots are not summed across replicas.

targets.expr: max by (state) (campusgo_user_accounts{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) and on() (((time() - max(campusgo_telemetry_heartbeat_seconds{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) < 45)) and on() (max(campusgo_user_snapshot_available{service_name="user-service",deployment_environment_name=~"${environment:regex}"}) == 1))

panels.title: Account snapshot age
panels.description: Immediate snapshot, then 30s after each completed read. Account values disappear after 90s without success.

panels.title: Account snapshot available
panels.description: 1 = successful snapshot at most 90s old. 0 = missing/stale snapshot. Unavailable = no fresh application heartbeat.
